objective: When each actual middle or padding name occurs at most twice and the repeated pairs across both roles are nested or disjoint in the supplied six-position order per stage, derive an indexed linear-time ordinary SAT algorithm even at unbounded nesting depth.
status: Proved: For a fixed order of middle and pad occurrences in each stage, arbitrary nesting of repeated pairs permits linear indexed decision. If deleting k repeated names restores nesting, both finding the deletion set and conditioning it cost O(2^k r) in total, irrespective of nesting depth or the raw number of crossings.
title: Reading paired choices from the innermost pair outward
